lines.text: David asks God to hear his complaint and to hide him from the scheming of the wicked mob.
The wicked sharpen their tongues like axes and ambush the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly and without fear.
The wicked hold fast to their evil purpose, speak of hiding their snares, and ask, "Who will see them?"
God will shoot the wicked with fire, and their own tongues will be turned against them.
All mankind will fear and proclaim God's work, and the righteous are called to rejoice in the LORD.
